d: In this video, Firstpost explains the controversy surrounding Kendall Jenner after the supermodel sparked backlash for wearing an Om-printed sarong during her Bahamas holiday. The mustard-yellow beach cover-up, featuring sacred Hindu symbols Om and Trishul, triggered criticism from Indian social media users, who questioned the use of religious symbols as fashion accessories. Many called out Kendall Jenner for cultural insensitivity, arguing that Hindu religious symbols deserve respect and should not be reduced to beachwear trends.
